A portable cabin in Gurgaon is a factory-built steel-frame and panel unit used as a site office, supervisor cabin, or staff room across DLF Phases 1-5, Cyber City, Sohna Road, Golf Course Road, MG Road, and the Manesar belt. SAMAN Portable manufactures these units at our Greater Noida factory and dispatches them ready-to-place to sites across Gurgaon, so your workspace is usable in days rather than weeks. This guide covers what drives the price, the sizes and build spec we make, delivery to Gurgaon, and the common questions buyers ask before they order.

What a portable cabin in Gurgaon costs (and what drives the price)

There is no single fixed rate for a portable cabin in Gurgaon, because the price moves with what you build. A small unfurnished site office costs far less per unit than a larger insulated cabin with a toilet, partition, and electricals. For an accurate figure, send your size and fit-out so we can quote against your exact requirement. The biggest cost factors are:

  • Size (length x width): larger floor area uses more frame, panel, and roofing.
  • Panel and insulation: single-skin panel versus ~50 mm insulated PUF sandwich panel for heat and noise control.
  • Fit-out: attached toilet, internal partitions, windows, doors, and finish level.
  • Electricals: wiring points, lighting, fan or air-conditioning provision.
  • Delivery distance: transit from our Greater Noida factory to your Gurgaon site.

Because we are the manufacturer and sell on an enquiry basis, you deal with the factory directly and get a quote built to your spec — not a generic catalogue rate. OWNER FACT NEEDED: confirm whether to publish any indicative ₹/sq ft market range for Gurgaon; the old page used ₹1,100–2,500/sq ft which is not verified and has been removed.

Portable cabin price guidance in Gurgaon

Most Gurgaon buyers want a starting figure before they enquire. Exact pricing depends on size, the wall panel you choose, the interior fit-out, and the transport distance to your site — so the figures below are indicative starting points, not fixed quotes. We confirm the firm price at quotation.

As a guide, a compact 6x6 ft security or guard cabin typically starts around ₹1.25 lakh. A 10x10 ft single-room office works out higher once flooring, wiring, and windows are added. A 10x20 ft office with a built-in toilet block sits higher again, and a large 30x10 ft team office is at the top of the standard range. PUF sandwich panels cost more than single-skin or cement board but insulate far better through Gurgaon's hot summers. GST applies on top, and the standard delivery charge from our Greater Noida factory is ₹3,000.

Portable cabin (indicative)Typical use
6x6 ftSecurity / guard cabin, site post
10x10 ftSingle-room site or warehouse office
10x20 ft with toiletStaff office with attached washroom
30x10 ftMulti-room team or admin office

Tell us your exact size and finish and we will send a clear, itemised quote.

Sizes and configurations we manufacture

Portable cabins are built to your floor plan, so sizes are flexible. Common Gurgaon use cases and the configurations that suit them:

  • Site / supervisor office: a compact single cabin for construction sites and project monitoring.
  • Cabin office: a portable cabin set up as a working office with insulation, windows, and electricals — suitable for IT and real-estate site teams.
  • Cabin with toilet: a unit with an attached washroom for longer site deployments.
  • Multi-unit layouts: two or more cabins joined or placed side by side for larger teams.

If you are unsure which size fits your plot and headcount, share the site dimensions and we will recommend a layout.

Portable cabins across Gurgaon's business and industrial zones

Gurgaon's demand for portable cabins is spread across its corporate corridors, industrial estates, and fast-moving construction belts, and each uses them differently:

  • Udyog Vihar (Phases 1–5, 122016) — manufacturing and warehousing units use portable cabins as supervisor offices, security cabins, and store rooms on the plot.
  • IMT Manesar (122051) — auto-component and engineering plants use them as shift offices, gate cabins, and quality-check rooms.
  • Sohna Road and Golf Course Extension — developers building commercial and residential towers use them as on-site project offices, sales cabins, and security posts.
  • Cyber City and the NH-48 corridor — fit-out contractors use them as movable site offices that relocate as work moves through the building.

For any site from Udyog Vihar to Manesar, a single truck delivers and places the cabin in a day. Because Gurgaon sits within easy reach of our Greater Noida factory across the NCR, transit is short.

Build specification — how our portable cabins are made

Every SAMAN portable cabin is built to a consistent manufacturing standard so it holds up on a working Gurgaon site:

  • Frame: MS (mild steel) structural frame to IS 2062, powder-coated for corrosion resistance.
  • Walls and roof: ~50 mm insulated PUF sandwich panels (40 kg/m³ minimum density) with a pre-galvanised steel skin; GI roofing.
  • Insulation: the PUF core helps keep interiors cooler through Gurgaon summers and reduces outside noise.
  • Quality system: manufactured under an ISO 9001:2015 quality system.

This is a steel-frame and panel structure, not a shipping container — it is purpose-built as a cabin, fitted out to your requirement.

Customisation options

Tell us how the cabin will be used and we build around it: split AC points and extra power sockets for office use, internal partitions for a separate cabin or meeting area, a toilet and washbasin block built into the unit, a glass front for a reception or sales cabin, loft storage above the ceiling line, and anti-skid flooring for workshop or wet areas. Because every unit comes from our portable cabin range built to order, these are made into the cabin, not added on afterwards.

Delivery and installation to Gurgaon sites

Our Greater Noida factory is in the same NCR region as Gurgaon, which keeps transit short. Typical delivery details:

  • Transit: 3–5 days for standard units once the unit is ready; custom or fully fitted cabins follow a build-time estimate (commonly around 7–21 working days depending on the spec).
  • Delivery charge: ₹3,000 default delivery (final cost depends on site distance and access).
  • Placement: cabins arrive built and are placed on a prepared, level base; large or multi-unit orders may need crane or extra access at the site.
  • Service area: we deliver across Gurgaon including DLF Phases 1–5, Cyber City, Sohna Road, Golf Course Road, MG Road, and Manesar.

For Delhi-NCR sites, please note construction activity can be restricted during GRAP air-quality windows (typically October–February); dry-assembled factory-built cabins are generally not the focus of those construction bans, but confirm any site-specific rules with your local authority.

Why buy factory-direct from SAMAN Portable

SAMAN POS India Private Limited has been serving India since 2009 and was incorporated as SAMAN POS India Private Limited in 2019. Buying direct from the manufacturer gives you:

  • Factory-direct pricing and control: you order from the people who build the cabin, with no reseller markup.
  • Same-region dispatch: Greater Noida to Gurgaon is a short NCR run, keeping transit and freight down.
  • Warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. (The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.)
  • Returns: a 7-day return window from delivery (customer-paid return cost).
  • Track record: 500+ projects across India.

FAQs — portable cabins in Gurgaon


How long does delivery of a portable cabin to Gurgaon take?

Standard portable cabins typically reach Gurgaon sites in 3–5 days once the unit is ready, because we dispatch from our Greater Noida factory in the same NCR region. Custom or fully fitted cabins follow a build-time estimate, commonly around 7–21 working days depending on size, insulation, and fit-out.


What decides the price of a portable cabin in Gurgaon?

Price depends on the cabin size, panel type and insulation (single-skin versus ~50 mm PUF), fit-out (toilet, partitions, windows, electricals), finish level, and delivery distance to your site. Because we sell direct from the factory on an enquiry basis, send your requirement and we quote it exactly — there is no fixed per-square-foot rate.


Do I need a permit for a portable cabin in Gurgaon?

Permit rules for temporary structures vary by location and by who owns or governs the site, and may differ inside special zones such as Cyber City or industrial areas like Manesar. A portable cabin is a movable, dry-assembled unit, but you should confirm any temporary-structure approval with your local authority or site owner before installation.


What sizes of portable cabin can I get?

Cabins are built to your floor plan, from a compact single site office to larger cabin offices, cabins with an attached toilet, and multi-unit layouts for bigger teams. Share your plot dimensions and headcount and we will recommend a layout that fits.


Can a portable cabin handle Gurgaon's heat and monsoon?

Yes. Our cabins use ~50 mm insulated PUF sandwich panels that help keep interiors cooler in summer, with GI roofing built for monsoon rain and a powder-coated IS 2062 steel frame for durability. You can add air-conditioning provision and extra insulation for longer or office deployments.


Can the cabin be relocated if our site changes?

Yes. A portable cabin is designed to be moved. Single units can usually be lifted and transported as built; larger or multi-unit layouts may need dismantling and reassembly. Tell us the move details and we can advise on the right approach.

Get a quote for your Gurgaon portable cabin

Tell us your size, fit-out, and site location across Gurgaon and we will prepare a factory-direct quote. As the manufacturer, we build, deliver, and stand behind the unit.

Call +91 88616 22859 or send your requirement through our enquiry form. You can also reach us on WhatsApp +91 88616 22859. You may also explore our full portable cabin range or a ready cabin office configuration for site teams.
